limits.byte_cap_semantics: Read at most these bytes. Reaching an artifact transfer cap without EOF fails closed; max verified payload is cap minus one.
limits.time_cap_semantics: Elapsed budget checked between operations; socket timeout bounds blocking I/O, not a whole-process hard deadline.
